summary: 20 hours of read speech, meeting conversation, radio, parliament and talk recordings, music, household and outdoor sounds and speech in other languages, with no wake word, for every English wake-word detector. A detector streams every recording, and the board ranks it on how often per hour it woke, with a column for each kind of audio.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py: the `negatives-en-US` part of OpenVoiceOS/ww-stream-bench. The negatives hold 6 h of read speech, 4 h of meeting conversation, 4 h of radio, parliament and talk recordings, 2 h of music, 2 h of household and outdoor sounds, 2 h of speech in other languages: 20 hours in all. Its sources and their licences are in the dataset card.
